details:
Mozilla Firefox is an open-source web browser, designed for standards compliance, performance and portability.

Security Fix(es):

Sandbox escape in the Security: Process Sandboxing component of Mozilla Firefox. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to break out of the browser's process sandbox restrictions. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100760)

A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the JavaScript: WebAssembly component of Mozilla Firefox. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to cause memory corruption, potentially leading to a browser crash or arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100765)

Sandbox escape in the XUL component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4, Thunderbird 157, Thunderbird 153.4, and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100787)

An improper privilege management vulnerability exists in the Places component of Mozilla Firefox. A remote attacker could escalate privileges by interacting with the affected component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100824)

Use-after-free in the JavaScript Engine: JIT component of Mozilla Firefox. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to cause memory corruption, leading to denial of service or potentially arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100825)

The vulnerability allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service. The vulnerability exists due to an unspecified flaw in the Storage: StorageManager component when the component is used. A remote attacker can interact with the affected component to cause a denial of service. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100826)

Mitigation bypass in the Bookmarks & History component of Mozilla Firefox. The vulnerability exists due to improper security control enforcement in the Bookmarks & History component when the component is used, allowing a remote attacker to interact with the affected component to bypass a security mitigation. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100828)

Mitigation bypass in the DOM: Security component. The vulnerability exists due to improper security control enforcement in the DOM: Security component when the component is used. A remote attacker can interact with the affected component to bypass a security mitigation. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4 and Firefox 157.(CVE-2026-100829)
